backend.metadata: TiDB v8.5.6 unistore (upstream local development mode, not distributed TiKV)
backend.large_files: real MinIO S3 API on loopback, independent owned container and data directory

cache_policy: upstream hot-cache workload; Drive9 default read and metadata caches plus --trust-process-local-events for the isolated single-server deployment; no global cache eviction
durability: explicit --durability=fsync: fsync waits for remote commit; ordinary write/close may complete before remote upload; no extra fsync in timed upstream workloads
profile: none: all file paths, including .git, go through Drive9 remote persistent storage
cache_free_space_floor_override: 1% instead of Drive9 default 10% on the shared 98%-full partition; runner also enforces 2 GiB free before each sample
vane_cache_policy: direct_io for live file data; kernel attribute/entry TTL 60 seconds; connection-private inode counts; FULL per mutation
scope: Same-process, same-window alternating VaneFS/Drive9 pairs, three repetitions. Selected remaining costs: sequential write, hot stat, and warmed Git macro suite. Fixture preparation, verification, queue drains and cleanup are outside timers. No agent-owned builds/tests overlap measurements; unrelated host jobs remain active. Durability boundaries differ.
